start.description: BEGIN, where legs start: [x, y] = [easting, northing]

items.description: one tangent, from one PI to the next: a direction (exactly one of bearing, azimuth, deflection, angle_right) and the distance to the next PI; radius is the curve at the PI where this leg starts (a leg after the first). Or as text: "S 76°15'00\" E 650", "33 L 820 R=450"

bearing.description: quadrant bearing: N 47°30'15" E, S47-30-15W, N47E

deflection.description: the angle the alignment turns at the PI where this leg starts: '33 L', '18°30'00" RT', or a number with right positive; or its size with turn

distance.description: feet from this leg's PI to the next PI

radius.description: the curve at the PI where this leg starts (0 or omitted: none, which needs angle_points)

legs.description: the layout as bearings and distances, PI to PI from start -- as a report describes it: 'S 76° E 650 ft to PI-2, where it deflects 33° left on a 450 ft curve; then 820 ft...' is [{bearing: 'S 76 E', distance: 650}, {deflection: '33 L', radius: 450, distance: 820}, ...]

angle_points.description: allow interior PIs of radius 0: angle points, where the tangents meet with no curve -- a layout whose curves come later (default false: a missing radius is refused)

ids.description: what to copy parallel: one line, polyline, arc or circle, or several that join end to end (in order along them), offset together as one path. Reference elements ('BASE:LN-017') may be copied into this document

distance.description: how far, with side or toward

side.description: left or right of the direction the path runs: a line start to end, a polyline in vertex order, an arc or circle counter-clockwise, a chain in the order of ids

toward.description: a point on the side to offset to, the way a drafter clicks the side

through.description: a point the parallel passes through; the distance is measured square to the path

offsets.description: several parallels at once, right of the path's direction positive ('15L', '15R' say the side): [-15, 15] is both edges of a 30 ft pavement

join.description: outside corners: sharp extends the pieces to meet (default), round swings an arc about the corner

layer.description: layer of the copies; default the source's layer

color.description: named CAD color (black, red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, gray, white) or '#RRGGBB'
